connectors.description: Read pull requests, diffs, reviews, checks and your assigned issues with the GitHub CLI (gh). The one write: submitting your review and its line comments, only when you click Submit review.
Read the current branch and remotes of the workspace checkout so This branch can list its pull request.

Runs sh to open a terminal in a worktree, creating <repo>.hvir-worktrees/pr-N for a pull request first (after you confirm); keep review progress under ~/.hvir/pulls; find the city store and read city review packages.

Read Gas City beads with bd list only: pr-review and pr-pipeline beads in the workspace, and PR follow-ups (review comments, CI failures) in the city store the workspace routes to, to show city work on each pull request.

actions.title: List pull requests and assigned issues that need attention
actions.description: Read-only. Sections: branch, ready (yours, no reviewer or review yet), review (yours, in review), drafts, requested (reviews asked of you), issues (assigned to you). Rows are newest activity first, stacked pull requests kept together; pull rows carry lastActivity (latest review or comment by others), newSinceViewer, and stack (base-first numbers). 'omitted' counts rows dropped to fit the 8 KiB result.

actions.title: Read one pull request's review and check status
actions.description: Read-only. For a pull request number in the workspace's repository: state, draft, review decision, requested reviewers, and check counts with up to 10 failing check names.

actions.title: Check out a pull request in a new terminal
actions.description: Runs gh pr checkout <number> -R <repo> once in a new terminal at the workspace root, after you confirm in hvir. Works on the workspace's host, local or SSH, with gh approved for that host.

actions.title: Open a terminal in a worktree of this repository
actions.description: Opens a new terminal in another worktree of this repository, after you confirm in hvir. The path must be listed by git worktree list on the workspace's host.

actions.title: Open a pull request's branch in a new worktree
actions.description: Creates <repo>.hvir-worktrees/pr-<number> beside the workspace on the pull request's branch (git fetch, then git worktree add), or reuses it, and opens a terminal there after you confirm in hvir. Same-repository pull requests only.
